reports.biz: GPaak Equipments LLC Fake Medical Equipment Invoice Medicare Health Insurance Billing Phishing and Identity Theft Scam
reports.desc: GPAAK Equipment billed Medicare for durable medical products that were not prescribed for me, I do not need and never received.  I did report this to Medicare as fraud several times.  The billing to my medicare account was in 2025.
I ordered 5 items from their site; only 3 were delivered. Intermittent contact via email since May 7th, yet last email they sent was May 23 which they haven't responded to.

At 9:50 pm, I was told that I would only be charged $39 the first month for the subscription. 2 hours later, i was then charged $149 for the medication. When inquiring about the fee and what amount would I be charged the following month, I informed the company that I wanted to cancel my whole order. The company then stated that they could not refund me my $39 for the subscription because the order was already assessed. I then inquired about the rest of my funds and was then informed that they could not refund me the rest because the system would not allow them to do so once my order has been processed. This was then at 12:45ish am.

There was an ad on Facebook for Boston Scally Caps on clearance. I ordered two caps. I got an email saying my caps have been shipped, but it wasn’t from Boston Scally Caps. It was from Melvessina, not from Boston Scally as advertised. The ad used the same spokesman as BSC, which looking back it was probably AI. It was supposed shipped by the same company (DHL) as BSC uses, so I didn’t think much of it. The tracking supposedly went through Los Angeles customs, which I found odd since it was supposed to ship from Boston. The tracking afterwards made no sense at all. A month later, Melvessina claimed it was delivered; however, there was no documentation of the delivery, just their claim it was delivered. I emailed and questioned Melvessina about the delivery. They said they would investigate it, but I never heard back after their initial reply. I tried to follow up a week later but never heard back from them.
I placed an order for Jean and never received them. I’ve contacted them and they say they are going to refund part of my money but never have. I paid using ApplePay.

OrderedJune 30 3026. I  never rwceived order. Contacted the company
Nmumerous times
The last contact indicated tthey could offer 30% of the purchase price. I ANDOLUTELY REFUSED.
This was a spam and fraud. DO NOT ORDER. Address was located in MT US. but I was told it was shipped the package was shipped from China
Received a letter similar to another BBB complaintant offering possibility of a POD policy of $10 million

I hired an electrician based on his brother’s recommendations. The electrician name is Anthony Ramirez. I signed the contract online and sent money via Zelle to a phone number that the electrician provided me. The electrician (Anthony) failed to show up for work on several occasions, claiming he had injured his leg. It has been over a moths, and I asked him for a refund. The electrician says he will send the money, but he has not returned it.  When I told him to return my money back, he replied with a bible verses. I went to the police station and file and report Anthony. I have the case number with a criminal charges against the electrician because the police discovered a irregularity on the contract and licenses. Anthony was called by the police station and he does not returned my money. He still texting me bible verses.

The website https://johnsonandassociatesllc.com/ is a fake accounting firm. It uses a photo of my current colleague and gives him a different name (Robert Stevens) and then uses a former colleague's photo (David White) and his actual name. There is no business located at the address they provide on their website. When I looked up the domain, it said it was registered in AZ and the phone number 480-624-2599, which is linked to multiple scams.

I was trying to sell a Amazon gift card to gain some of my money back because I wasn't going to use it. The website stated instant cash and you have to go through a verification process. Theres no live person to talk to, the email is fake or not working, and the phone number doesn't exist. I tried to redeem my Amazon card and it said already redeemed. So this site took my money and no return.
